title: 4.1 Activate the Vault
concept: Complete Binary Tree representation and bottom-up Max Heap construction
objective: Build a Max Heap bottom-up: click each violating non-leaf (or swap child) from [2] -> [1] -> [0]!
controls: Click violating node/cell [2] -> [1] -> [0] to sift down
start_status: Step 1/3: Click the last non-leaf node (or its larger child) to sift down!
hints: Bottom-up build starts at the last non-leaf index, n/2 - 1. Sift it down below its larger child.
Move one index up and sift that node down the same way.
Finish with the root: it may need to sink more than one level.
